request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:MARKSMAN

layers.text: Change only his clothes, skin and the bomb: the red cap becomes a dented rusted iron pot helmet, keeping the goggles on its front; the red tunic becomes near-black dark brown patched leather with one lighter brown hide patch; the black bomb gets one wide band of hazard yellow and black diagonal stripes and a red-orange fuse spark; his skin a brighter, more saturated yellow-olive green. Keep the face, ears, raised bomb, satchel, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style the same.
